name: Disibility
description: Comprehensive syllabus on disability specializations, early intervention, human resource and legal frameworks, educational tools, and assistive technologies for the District Selection Committee (DSC) exam.

topics.name: Fundamentals of Disability and Legal Frameworks
topics.description: Basic concepts, definitions, legal provisions, prevention, prevalence, and cross-disability approaches.

subtopics.name: Core Terminologies and Concepts
subtopics.description: Understanding core terms used in disability studies.

concepts.name: Handicap, Impairment, and Disability
concepts.description: Distinction and definitions of handicap, impairment, disability, and activity limitation.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand the differences between impairment, disability, handicap, and activity limitation as defined by WHO.

concepts.name: Habilitation and Rehabilitation
concepts.description: Concepts, objectives, and strategies in habilitation and rehabilitation of persons with disabilities.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between habilitation and rehabilitation processes and their importance.

subtopics.name: Legal Provisions, Prevention, and Demographics
subtopics.description: Benchmark disabilities, Indian legal framework, causes, prevention, and demographics.

concepts.name: Benchmark Disabilities and Legal Rights in India
concepts.description: Categories of benchmark disabilities under RPwD Act 2016 and legal rights provided in India.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify benchmark disabilities recognized under Indian law and explain the associated legal provisions.

concepts.name: Causes, Prevention, and Demographic Profile
concepts.description: Overview of primary, secondary, and tertiary prevention, along with global and national prevalence rates.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze the causes of disability and demographic distribution at national and global levels.

concepts.name: Cross Disability Approach and Interventions
concepts.description: Meaning, significance, and implementation of cross-disability strategies and interventions.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the concept and necessity of a cross-disability approach in educational and social inclusion.

topics.name: Disability Specializations and Educational Implications
topics.description: Detailed study of specific disability conditions, assessment, tools, and educational strategies.

subtopics.name: Sensory and Communication Disabilities
subtopics.description: Visual impairment, hearing impairment, deaf-blindness, and speech/language disabilities.

concepts.name: Visual Impairment (VI) and Deaf-Blindness
concepts.description: Definition, causes, classification, sensory training, and expanded core curriculum for VI and Db.
concepts.learning_objective: Describe anatomy, physiological impacts, and educational adaptations for students with VI and Deaf-Blindness.

concepts.name: Hearing Impairment and Speech/Language Disability
concepts.description: Nature, classification, amplification devices, linguistic and non-linguistic communication strategies.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify assessment methods, amplification devices, and communication modalities for HI and speech disorders.

subtopics.name: Intellectual, Developmental, and Learning Disabilities
subtopics.description: ID, SLD, and Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).

concepts.name: Intellectual Disability (ID) and Specific Learning Disability (SLD)
concepts.description: Definition, classification, causes, screening tools, assessment, and management of ID and SLD.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain screening, educational management, and learning adaptations for students with ID and SLD.

concepts.name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
concepts.description: Characteristics, early identification, screening, behavioral interventions, and educational strategies for ASD.
concepts.learning_objective: Recognize the core traits of ASD and apply suitable behavioral and educational interventions.

subtopics.name: Locomotor, Neuromuscular, and Multiple Disabilities
subtopics.description: Cerebral Palsy, Amputees, Polio, SCI, Spina-bifida, Muscular Dystrophy, and Multiple Disabilities.

concepts.name: Cerebral Palsy and Neuromuscular Conditions
concepts.description: Classification, anatomy, movement impairment, management, and therapeutic aids for CP and Muscular Dystrophy.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand physical limitations and classroom modifications required for Cerebral Palsy and muscular disorders.

concepts.name: Multiple Disabilities and Other Disabling Conditions
concepts.description: Characteristics, challenges, transdisciplinary support, and educational planning for Multiple Disabilities (MD).
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze the complexities and support structures required for children with multiple disabilities.

subtopics.name: Assessment Procedures and Life Transition Support
subtopics.description: PRASHAST, early identification domains, transition management, and guidance.

concepts.name: Screening and Assessment Tools (PRASHAST)
concepts.description: Screening procedures, evaluation tools, PRASHAST app/checklist, and domains of early identification.
concepts.learning_objective: Demonstrate knowledge of screening tools like PRASHAST for identifying disabilities in school settings.

concepts.name: Vocational Rehabilitation, Transition, and Counseling
concepts.description: Transition planning from home to school and school to work, job placement, and guidance/counseling.
concepts.learning_objective: Design transition plans and understand vocational placement strategies for individuals with disabilities.

topics.name: Early Identification, Intervention, and Inclusive Pedagogy
topics.description: Evidence-based practices, early childhood education, IEP/IFSP, classroom management, and PBIS.

subtopics.name: Inclusive Early Childhood Education (ECE)
subtopics.description: Evidence-based practices, service delivery models, and Universal Design for Learning (UDL).

concepts.name: Evidence-Based Early Intervention and Service Delivery Models
concepts.description: Principles, evidence-based practices, and models of service delivery in early childhood intervention.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify effective early intervention strategies and service delivery options for young children with special needs.

concepts.name: Universal Design for Learning (UDL) in ECE
concepts.description: Importance and application of Universal Design for Learning principles in early childhood education programs.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply UDL principles to design inclusive learning environments for early childhood classrooms.

subtopics.name: Individualized Planning (IEP and IFSP)
subtopics.description: Developing and implementing IEP and IFSP across different educational environments.

concepts.name: Concept and Components of IEP and IFSP
concepts.description: Definitions, core structural components, and evaluation of Individualized Educational Programmes and Family Support Plans.
concepts.learning_objective: Differentiate between IEP and IFSP and construct key components of an individualized plan.

concepts.name: Developing IEP across Diverse Settings
concepts.description: Customizing IEPs for home-based teaching programs, special schools, and inclusive general classrooms.
concepts.learning_objective: Formulate setting-specific IEP goals for home, special, and inclusive school environments.

subtopics.name: Teaching Strategies and Behavioral Support
subtopics.description: Group/individual teaching methods, co-teaching models, and PBIS.

concepts.name: Instructional Strategies and Group Teaching
concepts.description: Methods for individual, small group, and large group instruction in special and inclusive classrooms.
concepts.learning_objective: Select and implement appropriate grouping and instructional strategies based on learner needs.

concepts.name: Classroom Management and Co-Teaching Models
concepts.description: Team teaching, shadow teaching, peer tutoring, cooperative learning, and collaborative practice.
concepts.learning_objective: Utilize team teaching, peer support, and cooperative learning to maintain inclusive classroom dynamics.

concepts.name: Positive Behavioral Intervention Strategies (PBIS)
concepts.description: Principles, assessment, and implementation of PBIS and therapeutic intervention strategies.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply PBIS techniques and therapeutic services to address challenging behaviors and foster positive learning environments.

topics.name: Human Resources, Policies, and Organizations in Disability Sector
topics.description: HRD, national institutes, international bodies, conventions, and government welfare schemes.

subtopics.name: Human Resource Development and Ethics
subtopics.description: Status, requirements, challenges, and ethical standards for professionals in the disability sector.

concepts.name: HRD Status, Needs, and Ethics in Disability Sector
concepts.description: Current status, training needs, critical issues, and ethical frameworks governing professional practice.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify HRD gaps and articulate professional ethical guidelines when working with persons with disabilities.

subtopics.name: International Bodies, Declarations, and Frameworks
subtopics.description: Global policy frameworks, declarations, and international organizations involved in disability rights.

concepts.name: Role of International Organizations
concepts.description: Contributions of IDA, UNESCO, UNICEF, UNDP, and WHO to rehabilitation and disability services.
concepts.learning_objective: Detail the objectives and roles of major international agencies in disability advocacy and service.

concepts.name: International Conventions and Frameworks
concepts.description: UNCRPD, UNESCAP, Salamanca Declaration, MDGs, SDGs, Biwako Millennium Framework, CBM, and ICEVI.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze key recommendations of major global frameworks like UNCRPD and Salamanca Statement.

subtopics.name: National Institutes and Government Welfare Schemes
subtopics.description: Indian apex institutes, state welfare initiatives, and cross-disability inclusion policies.

concepts.name: National Institutes under Disability Sector in India
concepts.description: Roles and functions of AYJNISLD, ISLRTC, NIEPID, NIEPMD, NIEPVD, NILD, NIMHR, PDUNIPPD, and SVNIRTAR.
concepts.learning_objective: List and explain the target groups and functions of India's apex national institutes for disability.

concepts.name: Government Schemes and Cross-Disability Initiatives
concepts.description: Welfare schemes, educational provisions for CWSN, and cross-disability inclusion strategies in India.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify key government schemes, benefits, and statutory provisions available for children with special needs.

topics.name: Educational Tools, ICT, and Assistive Technologies
topics.description: Assessment tools, AAC, assistive hardware/software, screen readers, accessible apps, and computer/internet skills.

subtopics.name: Evaluation Tools and Assistive/AAC Devices
subtopics.description: Types of evaluation tools, assistive devices, and augmentative & alternative communication systems.

concepts.name: Assessment Tools and Assistive Devices
concepts.description: Educational evaluation types, diagnostic tools, and adaptive hardware for classroom learning.
concepts.learning_objective: Evaluate and select appropriate assessment tools and assistive devices for diverse disabling conditions.

concepts.name: Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC)
concepts.description: Unaided and aided AAC systems, communication boards, and speech-generating devices.
concepts.learning_objective: Design and use low-tech and high-tech AAC solutions for non-verbal or speech-impaired learners.

subtopics.name: ICT and Assistive Software for CWSN
subtopics.description: ICT evolution, input/store devices, screen readers, accessible libraries, and mobility software.

concepts.name: ICT Fundamentals and Hardware/Software Inputs
concepts.description: Scope and evolution of ICT, major input/output/storage devices tailored for students with disabilities.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the role of specialized computer hardware and software in facilitating accessible learning.

concepts.name: Screen Readers and Online Accessible Libraries
concepts.description: Screen reading software for PCs and mobiles (e.g., NVDA, TalkBack) and digital accessible library platforms.
concepts.learning_objective: Utilize screen reading software and access online digital libraries designed for visually impaired users.

concepts.name: Mobility, Navigation, and Recreational Software Apps
concepts.description: GPS-based mobility apps, object recognition applications, and accessible gaming/recreational software.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify mobile applications that assist students in navigation, object identification, and recreation.

subtopics.name: Computer Applications and Internet Utilities
subtopics.description: Ease of access features, MS Office, internet utilities, speech synthesizers, and online learning tools.

concepts.name: Basic Computer Operations and Accessibility Settings
concepts.description: Keyboard skills, Windows operations, Ease of Access features, MSOffice applications, and alternative input methods.
concepts.learning_objective: Configure Windows Ease of Access settings and utilize core desktop software with adaptive modifications.

concepts.name: Internet Applications, Cloud Services, and Speech Synthesizers
concepts.description: Google Search, Google Drive, E-mail, text-to-speech synthesizers, and adaptive internet browsing techniques.
concepts.learning_objective: Utilize cloud storage, email, and speech synthesis tools for efficient teaching and online research.

concepts.name: Online Collaboration and Adaptive Communication
concepts.description: Using chat, social media, and online meeting platforms (Zoom/Teams/Google Meet) for teaching and inclusive learning.
concepts.learning_objective: Conduct virtual teaching sessions using adaptive communication tools and accessible online platforms.
